platform: Linux aarch64 Docker VM on Apple M1 Max

method.file_load: freshly written private temporary files on container filesystem; warm page cache

limits: Single run of each case per stage; three repeated timing rounds in the same child process.
p50/p95 describe batch means, not individual-request tail latency.
Includes Router::decide normalization and Decision disposal; excludes traffic, DNS, TUN, QUIC, source-line explanation and lint.
Main config parsing and other startup work are excluded from setup times.
RSS includes benchmark generators, configuration, test harness and allocator retention; not index heap size.
CIDR workloads use fixed /24 IPv4 and /32 IPv6 prefixes; varied-prefix correctness is tested separately.
Host activity and CPU frequency were not controlled; no production throughput guarantee.
